Container.Name: Outpost
Container.Overview: Outpost is a self-hosted, themeable weather dashboard for wall-mounted displays, tablets, and phones, with a retro terminal look. It shows current conditions, an hourly and 5-day forecast, official alerts, air quality, an optional map with rain radar, and sensor and power readings from Home Assistant or MQTT. Weather comes from Open-Meteo by default (no key needed); the National Weather Service, MET Norway, Pirate Weather, and OpenWeatherMap are also available. Set your latitude and longitude, then open the web UI. All settings are described in the README.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port for the dashboard (container port 80).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where Outpost keeps weather.json and its settings for the dashboard, so they survive restarts.

Config.Name: Your own themes
Config.Description: Optional: your own themes, one folder each with a theme.css (see docs/themes.md). Restart the container after adding one.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: Weather data source. See Weather providers.

Config.Name: Location name
Config.Description: Name shown at the top of the dashboard.

Config.Name: Latitude
Config.Description: Latitude in decimal degrees.

Config.Name: Longitude
Config.Description: Longitude in decimal degrees.

Config.Name: Units
Config.Description: imperial (°F, mph, inHg, miles) or metric (°C, km/h, hPa, km), for the dashboard and weather.json.

Config.Name: Theme
Config.Description: Dashboard look. See Themes.

Config.Name: Contact
Config.Description: Your email address or website, so weather services can reach you. Recommended for nws, metno, and auto (and NWS alerts). It is sent in the User-Agent header, after the project page that Outpost always includes.

Config.Name: Pirate Weather API key
Config.Description: Your free Pirate Weather API key, for pirateweather, or for auto to use Pirate Weather outside the Nordic countries and the US (and as a fallback there). Keep it private; it is only sent to Pirate Weather.

Config.Name: OpenWeatherMap API key
Config.Description: Your OpenWeatherMap API key with a "One Call by Call" subscription, for openweathermap. Only home uses it. Keep it private; it is only sent to OpenWeatherMap. See OpenWeatherMap.

Config.Name: OpenWeatherMap plan
Config.Description: Which OpenWeatherMap services your key can use: onecall (One Call API 3.0, which needs the "One Call by Call" subscription) or free (the free services, which need only an account). See OpenWeatherMap.

Config.Name: Alerts provider
Config.Description: Where official alerts come from: auto (the weather provider's own; else NWS in the US; else MET Norway in Norway; else OpenWeatherMap when the weather is from it; else Pirate Weather when you have a key), nws, metno, pirateweather, openweathermap, or none. See Alerts.

Config.Name: Theme switcher
Config.Description: Show the on-screen button for the panel with the location search, themes, and display options. Set false for a kiosk display.

Config.Name: Community themes
Config.Description: Community themes to download when the container starts, as username/theme separated by commas. See Community themes.

Config.Name: Community themes ref
Config.Description: Which version of the community themes to download: a branch, tag, or commit.

Config.Name: Effects
Config.Description: reduced turns off scanlines, glow, and animation for everyone. See Reduced effects.

Config.Name: Effects toggle
Config.Description: Show the "Reduced effects" checkbox in the theme panel. Set false so viewers cannot change OUTPOST_EFFECTS.

Config.Name: Auto dim
Config.Description: Dim the display at night. See Day/night dimming.

Config.Name: Dim level
Config.Description: Night brightness, from 0.05 (very dark) to 1 (no dimming).

Config.Name: Dim mode
Config.Description: sun follows sunset and sunrise; schedule uses fixed times.

Config.Name: Dim start
Config.Description: Night window for schedule mode (24-hour HH:MM).

Config.Name: Dim end
Config.Description: Night window for schedule mode (24-hour HH:MM).

Config.Name: Clock
Config.Description: 12 shows times like 1:05 PM, 24 like 13:05, on every theme. auto follows the viewing browser's language, not the device's 12/24-hour clock setting (browsers do not share it), so a browser in US English shows 12-hour times. Each screen can also choose with the "24-hour clock" checkbox in the theme panel (saved in that browser), or ?clock=12 / ?clock=24 in the address.

Config.Name: Clock toggle
Config.Description: Show the "24-hour clock" checkbox in the theme panel. Set false so viewers cannot change OUTPOST_CLOCK.

Config.Name: Subtitle
Config.Description: Optional line under the title. Empty hides it; {date} and {time} show the current date and time.

Config.Name: Hourly
Config.Description: The hourly forecast at the top of the forecast panel: the next hours with their temperature and chance of rain. false hides it.

Config.Name: Air quality
Config.Description: Air quality and pollen on the dashboard and in weather.json, from the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service's forecasts through Open-Meteo. false turns it off. See Air quality.

Config.Name: Air quality index
Config.Description: us (US AQI) or european (European Air Quality Index); auto uses the US AQI in the US and its territories and the European one everywhere else.

Config.Name: Alerts always show
Config.Description: false hides the Alerts panel when there are none; true always shows it. See Alerts.

Config.Name: Mock alerts
Config.Description: With the mock provider, true always includes sample alerts (one of each severity), for trying how alerts look. See Alerts.

Config.Name: Location search
Config.Description: Whether screens may show places other than home. See Other places.

Config.Name: Location limit
Config.Description: Weather fetches an hour for places other than home, all of them together (0 or more). See Other places.

Config.Name: Location Pirate Weather
Config.Description: Whether other places may use the Pirate Weather key, only from the quota home won't need before the monthly reset. false keeps it for home.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Show a map of the place shown, drawn from OpenStreetMap. Needs OUTPOST_CONTACT with the default tile server. See Map.

Config.Name: Map zoom
Config.Description: How close the map is: 4 (a large region) to 12 (a town).

Config.Name: Map tiles
Config.Description: Another server for the map's vector tiles, such as https://tiles.example.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt. It must use the Shortbread schema.

Config.Name: Map radar
Config.Description: Rain radar on the map: NOAA in the US, RainViewer elsewhere. See Map.

Config.Name: Map radar loop
Config.Description: Play the past 2 hours of radar as a loop instead of showing the latest frame (never on ePaper or with reduced effects).

Config.Name: Sensors
Config.Description: Home Assistant entities or MQTT topics for the sensor panel, separated by commas, such as sensor.living_room_temperature, Garage=binary_sensor.garage_door, Shed=mqtt:shed/temperature. See Sensors and MQTT.

Config.Name: Power home
Config.Description: Home Assistant entity (or mqtt: topic) with the home's power use, for the power panel. See Power.

Config.Name: Power solar
Config.Description: Entity with solar production.

Config.Name: Power grid
Config.Description: Entity with grid power, positive when importing and negative when exporting.

Config.Name: Power grid invert
Config.Description: true for a grid meter that counts exports as positive.

Config.Name: Power battery
Config.Description: Entity with the battery's charge in percent.

Config.Name: Sensors interval
Config.Description: Seconds between sensor and power readings from Home Assistant (at least 5). MQTT readings arrive when they change.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Your Home Assistant, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123, for the sensors and power. Not needed in the add-on.

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: A long-lived access token for OUTPOST_HA_URL. Keep it private; it is only sent to Home Assistant. Not needed in the add-on.

Config.Name: MQTT host
Config.Description: Your MQTT broker, such as mqtt.local or 192.168.1.20, for mqtt: readings. See MQTT. The add-on uses the Mosquitto broker add-on when this is empty.

Config.Name: MQTT port
Config.Description: The broker's port (8883 by default with TLS).

Config.Name: MQTT username
Config.Description: The broker login, if it needs one.

Config.Name: MQTT password
Config.Description: The broker password. Keep it private; it is only sent to the broker.

Config.Name: MQTT TLS
Config.Description: true to connect with TLS. The broker's certificate must be valid for OUTPOST_MQTT_HOST.

Config.Name: Update interval
Config.Description: Seconds between data updates (at least 60). Each weather service is still asked no more often than it allows; see Request limits.

Config.Name: User agent
Config.Description: Advanced: replaces the whole User-Agent (normally Outpost/<version> (<contact>; +https://github.com/maxtrax04/outpost)).

Config.Name: Frame ancestors
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of sites allowed to show Outpost in a frame, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123 for a Home Assistant webpage card. Empty allows only Outpost itself. See SECURITY.md.
